tools.description: Read part or all of a file
List the contents of a folder
Find files by name, or every file under a folder
Check which tools, languages and Python packages are installed
Hand over to the coding model for its next turn

toolchain.description: Check which tools and languages are installed: python3, pip3, node, npm, gcc, g++, cc, make, cmake, java, perl, sqlite3, ...

arguments.command:
head -n 2 /etc/os-release 2>/dev/null || echo 'os-release: MISSING'
echo '--- programs ---'
for c in 'python3' 'pip3' 'node' 'npm' 'gcc' 'g++' 'cc' 'make' 'cmake' 'java' 'perl' 'sqlite3' 'curl' 'git' 'file' 'xxd' 'od' 'ps' 'pgrep' 'ss' 'strings'; do p=$(command -v "$c") && echo "$c: $p" || echo "$c: MISSING"; done
